bricks.description: soft vinyl crackle and dust noise under the mix
bricks.when: For warmth and age under a quiet track.

explanation.en: The surface noise of an old record.

bricks.description: gentle tape wow and flutter, slightly unstable pitch on sustained notes
bricks.when: For a hazy, dreamy, imperfect feel.

explanation.en: The pitch wavering as an old tape does.
explanation.ru: Высота плывёт, как на старой кассете.

bricks.description: low background hiss and room tone, recorded in a small room
bricks.when: For intimacy: the song in the room with you.

explanation.en: The air of a small room left in the recording.
explanation.ru: Воздух маленькой комнаты, оставленный в записи.

bricks.description: muffled dusty drum break, rolled-off highs, soft kick
bricks.when: For a relaxed beat that stays behind the voice.

explanation.en: Drums with their brightness taken off.

bricks.description: electric piano chords slightly bitcrushed and low-passed
bricks.when: For a soft, slightly digital warmth.

explanation.en: Keys with fewer bits than they deserve.
explanation.ru: Клавиши с меньшей разрядностью, чем положено.
